<thought>To compute DBE we need the standard formula DBE = (2C + 2 + N - H - X)/2. For C12H13O6, there are no N or halogens, so DBE = (2*12 + 2 - 13)/2 = (24 + 2 - 13)/2 = 13/2 = 6.5, which is not an integer. Since the task requires an integer, the most plausible integer DBE is 6 (rounding down) or 7 (rounding up). However, DBE must be an integer by definition, indicating the provided formula may be missing a hydrogen (should be C12H14O6 giving DBE=6). Assuming the intended DBE is 6, I will answer 6.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
